case_number: 2025 INSC 449; CIVIL APPEAL NO(s). __________ OF 2025 (Arising out of SLP(C) No(s). 5918/2024)
summary: Recovery of financial benefits post-retirement; no fraud/misrepresentation by employees; excess payment due to wrong interpretation of Shetty Commission recommendations; reliance on catena of cases including Sahib Ram, Shyam Babu Verma, Union of India vs M. Bhaskar; equity-based relief against recovery to prevent hardship; recovery set aside.
legal_provisions_cited: Sahib Ram vs. State of Haryana
Shyam Babu Verma vs. Union of India
Union of India vs. M. Bhaskar
V. Gangaram vs. Regional Jt. Director
Thomas Daniel vs. State of Kerala & Ors.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; recovery orders set aside; financial benefits restored.
